a: Upon a security check, a [Security] effect will immediately activate without pending activation.
For other triggered effects, the turn player activates their effects first.
Card Q&A.q: In what order do a [Security] effect, "when [...] performs a security check" effect, and "when a card is removed from [...] security stack" effect activate when they trigger simultaneously upon a security check?

Effect: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with the [Reptile] or [Dragonkin] trait and 1 card with the [LIBERATOR] trait among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
Inherited Effect: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When your opponent's security stack is removed from, gain 1 memory.
